The 5-hour and weekly windows, as Claude Code reports them, and your budget.

Ready-made rules for this folder: a few lines in CLAUDE.md, and for some a tighter safety belt.
For a repository anyone can read: no secrets in files, main changes only through pull requests.
- This repository is public. Never write secrets (keys, tokens, passwords) into files,
- Change the main branch only through pull requests; work on a branch.
